points.statement: The method aims to recover high-quality images harmed by adverse weather.
points.quote: Our goal is to restore high-quality images degraded by adverse weather conditions.

points.statement: It creates degradation-aware prompts by combining semantic embeddings.
points.quote: generates degradation-aware cross-modal prompts by integrating semantic embeddings

points.statement: Attention is refined progressively toward degraded regions using an alignment strategy.
points.quote: progressively refines attention to degraded regions through an alignment strategy

points.statement: It separates degradation artifacts from clean scene content to restore details accurately.
points.quote: disentangles degradation artifacts from clean scene content for accurate detail restoration

points.statement: Textual embeddings and visual features are combined to produce prompts aware of degradation.
points.quote: integrates textual embeddings with visual features to produce degradation-aware prompts

points.statement: Semantic information is adaptively aligned with degraded regions to support context-aware restoration.
points.quote: adaptively aligns semantic information with degraded regions to facilitate context-aware restoration

points.statement: It separates degradation artifacts from scene structures.
points.quote: disentangles degradation artifacts from scene structures

points.statement: This improves reconstruction of fine textures and detailed content.
points.quote: improving the reconstruction of fine textures and detailed content
